description: This file defines the PipelineElement interface which represents an element in a processing pipeline, including methods for processing, transformation, and evaluation within the pipeline.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the pipeline element, indicating if it is resolved, unresolved, or deleted.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Advances a resolved value to the next pipeline stage using a provided function.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Advances an unresolved value to the next pipeline stage using a supplier.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Advances a deleted or signifying element to the next pipeline stage using a supplier.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Evaluates the pipeline element via a visitor pattern, returning a result of a generic type.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms a resolved value by applying a function, leaving other elements unchanged.

methods.name: orElse
methods.description: Combines this pipeline element with another, following a specific lattice logic for unresolved, resolved, and deleted states.

methods.name: toOptional
methods.description: Converts the pipeline element into an Optional<String>, abstracting deletion and resolution failure.
